title: The Decision of the Panchayat
lesson: To understand ‘The Decision of the Panchayat’, begin with the situation presented in the chapter and identify what is happening. Focus on a dispute over water and evidence and claims, then look for evidence for fair decision making. Finally, explain what you learned and how the idea can guide a decision or observation outside the chapter.
